_comment: The Python an installed claude-voice runs on: python.org's own full build for Windows, as a plain zip (the package the Python install manager uses, listed in https://www.python.org/ftp/python/index-windows.json with this hash). Every file in it is signed by the Python Software Foundation, which is what Smart App Control lets run. 3.12, not 3.13: Smart App Control refused the cp313 build of a Pocket dependency (sentencepiece) that it allows as cp312 -- see requirements-pocket.txt. 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 with Windows binaries; moving to 3.13 means re-checking every compiled wheel under SAC first. install.ps1 pins the same three values and test_installer.py checks the two agree; the Immersive AI mod reads them from here.
